why: Searches for improved bounds on Skewes's number (the smallest x with pi(x) > li(x)) turn up only pre-2024 results: upper bound e^727.951336105 (~1.398e316) by Saouter, Trudgian and Demichel (2015) and lower bound 1.39e17 by Platt and Trudgian; no post-January-2024 source reports a tighter bound or resolution.
